about.hero_desc: We're gamers, tech enthusiasts, and repair specialists — dedicated to keeping Brunei's gaming community powered up.
about.story_p1: Casual Gamerz started as a passion project in 2012 — two friends who loved gaming and hated seeing perfectly good devices thrown away over fixable faults. We started repairing controllers and consoles for friends, and word spread fast.
about.story_p2: By 2016 we had a proper workshop, a team of certified technicians, and a reputation for fixing things others said couldn't be fixed. We've since serviced over 1,000 devices — from vintage game consoles to the latest PS5 and high-end gaming rigs.
about.story_p3: Today, Casual Gamerz is Brunei's go-to tech repair center. We stock genuine parts, offer warranties on every repair, and treat every device like it's our own. Gaming is our culture — fixing it is our craft.

values_cards.title: Speed Without Compromise
values_cards.desc: We know every hour without your setup matters. Our 24–48 hour turnaround is a promise, not a goal — and we back it with our on-time guarantee.

values_cards.title: Genuine Parts Only
values_cards.desc: We source only genuine OEM or certified-equivalent parts. No grey market components, ever. Your device deserves parts that last.

values_cards.title: Gamers Who Get It
values_cards.desc: Every technician on our team is an active gamer. We speak your language and we understand exactly what's at stake when your rig goes down.

values_cards.title: Transparent Pricing
values_cards.desc: We quote before we repair. No surprise charges, no hidden fees. You'll always know exactly what you're paying for before we start.

values_cards.title: 90-Day Guarantee
values_cards.desc: All repairs are guaranteed for 90 days. If the same issue comes back, we fix it at no charge. That's our commitment to quality.

values_cards.title: Community First
values_cards.desc: We give back to the Brunei gaming community through sponsorships, tournaments, and free workshops for young tech enthusiasts.

services.hero_desc: Comprehensive repair and upgrade solutions for every gaming device and computer.

pc_cards.title: Overheating & Cooling
pc_cards.desc: Thermal paste replacement, fan cleaning, heatsink upgrades, and custom liquid cooling installations.

pc_cards.title: Power Supply Repair
pc_cards.desc: PSU diagnostics, replacement with certified units, cable management, and surge protection setup.

pc_cards.title: GPU Upgrade & Repair
pc_cards.desc: Graphics card installation, bios reflash, VRAM repair, and performance benchmarking after service.

pc_cards.title: Motherboard Repair
pc_cards.desc: Trace repair, capacitor replacement, POST diagnostics, BIOS recovery, and chipset troubleshooting.

laptop_cards.title: Screen Replacement
laptop_cards.desc: IPS, OLED, and 144Hz screen replacement for all brands — Asus, HP, Lenovo, Dell, MacBook, Acer and more.

laptop_cards.title: Battery Replacement
laptop_cards.desc: Genuine replacement batteries for all laptop models. We test capacity before and after replacement.

laptop_cards.title: Water Damage Recovery
laptop_cards.desc: Ultrasonic cleaning, component-level corrosion removal, and full board rehabilitation for liquid damage.

laptop_cards.title: Keyboard & Trackpad
laptop_cards.desc: Full keyboard replacement, individual key fixes, trackpad calibration, and palm rest repairs.

console_cards.title: PlayStation Repair
console_cards.desc: PS3, PS4, PS4 Pro, PS5 — HDMI port replacement, disc drive repair, overheating fixes, and BLOD/YLOD repair.

console_cards.title: Xbox Repair
console_cards.desc: Xbox One, Series S/X — disc drive, HDMI, power brick, controller repair, and system software recovery.

console_cards.title: Nintendo Switch Repair
console_cards.desc: Joycon drift, screen cracks, charging port, dock issues, USB-C replacement, and banned account recovery.

console_cards.title: Steam Deck & Handheld
console_cards.desc: Steam Deck screen, joystick, and SSD upgrades. Also servicing ROG Ally, Lenovo Legion Go, and more.

sw_cards.title: Virus & Malware Removal
sw_cards.desc: Deep scan, complete malware/ransomware removal, browser cleanup, and preventive security setup.

sw_cards.title: OS Installation
sw_cards.desc: Clean install of Windows 10/11 or macOS, driver setup, and essential software configuration.

sw_cards.title: Data Recovery
sw_cards.desc: Recovery from failing HDDs, SSDs, corrupted partitions, accidental deletions, and formatted drives.

sw_cards.title: Performance Tuning
sw_cards.desc: FPS optimization, startup speed boost, driver updates, background process cleanup, and gaming mode setup.

peri_cards.title: Joystick Drift Fix
peri_cards.desc: Fix analog stick drift on PS4/PS5, Xbox, Switch Joycon controllers using Hall effect sensor upgrades.

peri_cards.title: Gaming Mouse Repair
peri_cards.desc: Micro switch replacement, scroll wheel, cable repair, sensor cleaning for Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries and more.

peri_cards.title: Mechanical Keyboard
peri_cards.desc: Switch replacement, PCB repair, stabilizer lubing, keycap restoration, and RGB firmware flashing.
